messages:
sarah_support: Customer says promo code showed 'Accepted' in the UI but their "credits" balance is still $0. Account ID ACCT-12345. Customer email attached: 'redeemed, confirmation email received, but dashboard shows 0 credits'. Can billing + eng take a look?

jason_billing: I'm looking. Can you paste the customer's org_id and the exact promo code they used? Also any claim id from the confirmation email would help.

sarah_support: Org id shown in our support UI: ACCT-12345. Promo: SPRING-100GIFT. Confirmation email claim id: claim_7f9b2a. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal/screens/xxxx

jason_billing: Ran a quick query against promo_grants: 
```
SELECT id, org_id, amount, status, created_at FROM promo_grants WHERE claim_id='claim_7f9b2a';
```
Result: grant exists but org_id = "acct-test" and status = "applied" amount = 100000 (in cents). So the grant was applied — but to `acct-test` not the customer's org.

leo_engineer: Interesting — I see a path where the frontend normalizes orgs for our internal test harness. There's a mapping function that downcases and strips dashes for old accounts but when the claim arrives via the SPA it sometimes uses `org_meta.migrated_id` and we have a fallback mapping to a test org when the normalized id matches a pattern. Looks like `ACCT-12345` normalized -> `acct-12345` and a buggy regex matched `acct-` prefix which mapped to `acct-test`. Possibly a legacy mapping rule.

tayla_pm: Oof. So customer sees accepted, backend applied to test org. We need to reassign and patch so this doesn't recur. Estimated blast radius: only grants created by that redeem flow in the last 24h with that mapping pattern.

jason_billing: Proposed remediation: 1) create a one-off DB update to reassign promo_grants with claim_id 'claim_7f9b2a' from org_id 'acct-test' -> 'ACCT-12345' and increment the customer's spendable balance accordingly. 2) run a small audit query to find other grants that matched the same erroneous mapping in last 48h. 3) alert accounting and add a note to the ledger for traceability.

leo_engineer: I can produce the safe migration and a small script to verify row counts. SQL I plan to run (will run inside a tx, tested on staging):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE promo_grants SET org_id='ACCT-12345' WHERE claim_id='claim_7f9b2a' AND org_id='acct-test';
-- bump balance
UPDATE account_balances SET credits_cents = credits_cents + 100000 WHERE org_id='ACCT-12345';
INSERT INTO audit_notes (org_id, note) VALUES ('ACCT-12345', 'promo grant claim_7f9b2a re-assigned from acct-test');
COMMIT;
```
I'll run a dry-run SELECT first to show affected rows.

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4473 (label: billing-grant-misassign). Assigned to jason_billing, leo_engineer.

jason_billing: Approve the one-off migration now? I want to run the audit scope query first and post results here.

leo_engineer: Audit query results: found 3 grants in last 48h that were applied to `acct-test` with claim_ids [claim_7f9b2a, claim_8c3d1e, claim_a9f11c]. All have matching confirmation emails from customers. I'll prepare a batched migration to reassign those three.

tayla_pm: Good. Please include a customer-facing timeline blurb so support can reply. Sarah, can you draft?

sarah_support: Draft to send after fix: "Thanks — we found the grant was recorded to an internal test account due to a mapping bug. We've re-applied your credits to your account and you should see them in your dashboard within a few minutes. We're also pushing a fix so this won't happen again. Apologies for the confusion." Approving to send once migration completes. :thumbsup:

leo_engineer: Patch to fix mapping: normalize both sides and remove legacy fallback that maps `acct-` prefix to test org. I'll ship a small validation and add unit test. Will also add a monitor to alert if grants go to non-production orgs.

jason_billing: Migration executed, tx succeeded. Affected rows: 3 grants moved, balances updated. Ledger entries: appended audit notes. Monitoring: I'll keep an eye on daily billing run for any anomalies.

sarah_support: Sending customer message now. Please update thread if anything changes. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

leo_engineer: Follow-up: we merged the validation branch and added the monitor. If anyone sees similar tickets, link them here.

jason_billing: Closing INC-2026-4473 after verification. 

ops_bot: Incident INC-2026-4473 status changed to RESOLVED by jason_billing."
